operators.name: hardsigmoid_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference input [512, 1024, 1024] or arbitrary batch of float32 on cuda

semantics: Performs F.hardsigmoid elementwise on input tensor x: output = 0 if x <= -3, 1 if x >= 3, else (x + 3) / 6.
Preserves input shape, dtype, device and memory layout (output is a new contiguous tensor matching input strides).
Must handle non-contiguous inputs correctly by following strides; custom CUDA kernel should assume generic strided access or make contiguous internally.
Only CUDA float32 tensor is supported for this task; no other dtypes/devices required.
Applies hardsigmoid to x elementwise with the exact formula: 0 if x <= -3, 1 if x >= 3, else (x + 3) / 6.
Output tensor has same shape [512, 1024, 1024], dtype torch.float32, device cuda:0, and same stride [1048576, 1024, 1] as reference checkpoint.
The operation does not modify x; a new tensor is produced.
Returns the tensor produced by step_001 unchanged.
